# Lucide playback controls

These SVG originals are from lucide-icons/lucide at commit 55782beff3a0133df79c417eb68f96e8f19e2404. Android vector derivatives are generated by tests/generate-player-icons.py. Original and derived hashes are in metadata.json. The complete upstream ISC license and inherited Feather MIT notice are bundled in app/src/main/assets/third-party/Lucide-LICENSE.txt. Only the listed controls are included; no JavaScript runtime or remote icon requests are used.
